function_comment_regular: Load Oblivion Lighting30 pixel shaders. SM3023 is lighting\3x\SM3SimpleShadow.p.hlsl compiled with SOFTSHADOW=4 and DEPTHBIAS=-2. BaseMap.a : 1), A). With the SimpleShadow DESTCOLOR/ZERO pass blend, framebuffer RGB is multiplied by this pixel RGB. c7 is unused.
